name: Var
shape: Eurostat NUTS, the area it is named for
terms: Indication Géographique Protégée, the tier below AOC. It replaced vin de pays in 2009.

blurb.text: An IGP covering the whole Var department in Provence. Grenache, Cinsault and Syrah are the most planted grapes across the department's vineyards.
